<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
init_ascii = transitions[0].before_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_content(ascii_lines, r0, c0):
    content = []
    for dr in range(1, 5):
        row = ascii_lines[r0+dr][c0+1:c0+5]
        content.append(row)
    return tuple(content)

top_contents = {}
for ri in range(3):
    for ci in range(4):
        r0 = 4 + ri * 9
        c0 = 12 + ci * 10
        top_contents[(ri, ci)] = get_content(init_ascii, r0, c0)

curr_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
p0_content = get_content(curr_ascii, 50, 14)
print(f"Current P-0: {p0_content}")

# Press UP several more times to see the cycle
states = [p0_content]
for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    curr_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    content = get_content(curr_ascii, 50, 14)
    states.append(content)
    matched = None
    for (ri, ci), tc in top_contents.items():
        if content == tc:
            matched = f"Top({ri},{ci})"
            break
    print(f"UP #{i+3}: {content} -> {matched}")

print(f"\nUnique states: {len(set(states))}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
